Treated-group regression imputation gives about 3.95. I fitted an outcome model on the controls and predicted what the treated children would have scored without treatment. Averaging the gap between their actual and predicted scores gives 3.95.

The raw difference in means is 4.19, but the groups differ on covariates, so I preferred an adjusted estimate. Two other adjustments land close by: OLS with the treatment indicator gives 3.93 (that is an ATE-style estimate), and propensity-odds weighting of the controls gives 3.91.

ANSWER: 3.95
